sloka: सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छामि भोगांश्च मुनिपुङ्गव ।तारणे भगवन्मह्यं प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ७.७८.२६ ॥
transliteration: sarvānkāmānprayacchāmi bhogāṁśca munipuṅgava ।tāraṇe bhagavanmahyaṁ prasādaṁ kartumarhasi ।। 7.78.26 ॥

translations.english: The king pleaded with Agastya, "O best among sages, O venerable one, I grant all desires and enjoyments; please grant me the favor of liberation."
